name: Velvet Antenna v0.21.5 Velvet Lens
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna redesign focused on speed and a distinct browsing identity. v0.21.5 restores Jellyfin's native right-click and multi-select administration by keeping context-menu handling untouched and raising the native selection command bar above Velvet Antenna navigation, while retaining inline IDENTIFY, duplicate resolution badges and DELETE, native Series/Season functionality, subtitles and detail PLAY/CONTINUE.
